prompt: Who was the Prime Minister of Canada in the year that the 1965 winner of the Best New Artist Grammy Award made their first appearance on US television?
answer: The 1965 Best New Artist Grammy winner was **The Beatles**. They first appeared on U.S. television in **1964**, on *The Jack Paar Program* (January 3). Canada’s prime minister that year was **Lester B. Pearson**.
